firmographic.name: Linear
firmographic.company_description:
Linear is a cloud-based product development platform founded in 2019 and headquartered in San Francisco that serves software engineering and product organizations with issue tracking, sprint management, project planning, and roadmap coordination. The platform is structured around five integrated modules—Intake (AI-driven routing of customer feedback from Slack, Teams, Zendesk, Intercom, and Gong into actionable issues), Plan (projects, initiatives, documents, and visual roadmaps), Build (AI agent delegation and integration with Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor), Diffs (native code review with bidirectional GitHub sync), and Monitor (Pulse feeds, Insights analytics)—and exposes a public GraphQL API plus MCP server for external tool interoperability. Linear has built native AI capabilities including Linear Agent (an autonomous agent assignable to issues), Coding Sessions (cloud-sandbox code generation), Code Intelligence (codebase-grounded reasoning), and Triage Intelligence (automated routing and duplicate detection).

Linear monetizes through a tiered per-seat subscription model: a Free tier for individuals and small teams, Basic at $10 per user per month, Business at $16 per user per month (which bundles AI features like Triage Intelligence, Linear Agent automations, and Code Intelligence), and a quote-based Enterprise tier with SAML/SCIM, account management, and advanced security. The go-to-market combines a self-serve product-led growth motion (Free tier enabling viral team-by-team adoption) with a sales-assisted enterprise motion for larger contracts. Linear serves over 33,000 product teams and 15,000+ enterprise customers including OpenAI (3,000+ users), Ramp, Coinbase, Cursor, Perplexity, Scale AI, Opendoor, Oscar Health, Automattic, Brex, Cash App, Supercell, Vercel, and Mercury, and operates additional offices in London to support EMEA expansion.
firmographic.company_description_short: Linear is a cloud-based product development platform for software engineering teams, combining issue tracking, project planning, code review, and AI agent capabilities (Linear Agent, Coding Sessions, Code Intelligence). It serves over 33,000 product teams and 15,000+ enterprise customers via a tiered per-seat subscription.

recent_move.description: Launched Linear Agent in beta as an autonomous AI agent that can be assigned to issues like a teammate, supporting triage, issue creation, and delegation to coding agents, accompanied by a strategic narrative shift with CEO Karri Saarinen declaring issue tracking dead.

Closed $82 million Series C led by Accel at a $1.25 billion post-money valuation, reaching unicorn status with total funding of $134.2 million and a stated use of funds for product line expansion and larger enterprise customers.

Launched Coding Sessions enabling Linear Agent to write code using Claude Code and Codex in cloud sandboxes, completing an end-to-end triage-to-PR workflow inside Linear and converting the platform into a direct execution surface rather than purely a tracking system.

Opened a London office and consolidated revenue operations onto Stripe Tax, Data Pipeline, and Snowflake to support EMEA expansion, with COO Cristina Cordova publicly leading the narrative around international growth.

Joined Anthropic, Microsoft, and Okta as an initial partner for MCP Enterprise-Managed Authorization (EMA), positioning Linear as a foundational identity-aware MCP server for zero-touch AI agent authentication across enterprise environments.
Conducted the company's first tender offer in August 2025 to provide team members with liquidity, signaling post-unicorn maturity and secondary-market price discovery without disclosed amount.
Linear expanded into EMEA with a London office, supporting their expansion and revenue operations consolidation onto Stripe's platform.
recent_move.title: EMEA Expansion - London Office

expansion_highlight.description: Opened London office and consolidated revenue operations onto Stripe Tax, Data Pipeline, and Snowflake, signaling a deliberate push into EMEA with localized billing and data infrastructure.
Series C of $82M (June 2025) was explicitly earmarked to expand the product lineup and target larger enterprise customers, consistent with formal sales build-out and Enterprise-tier maturation.

Rapid 2026 product cadence—Coding Sessions, Code Intelligence, Linear Diffs, Project Slack channels, Agent MCP support, Releases, Multi-level sub-teams—broadens addressable surface from issue tracking into full SDLC workflow and code execution.

Partnerships with Anthropic, Microsoft, Okta, Cursor, Atlassian Rovo, and Stripe deepen the agent and enterprise ecosystem, increasing platform distribution and creating adjacencies into identity, observability, and AI tooling.
Addition of a Head of Sales (Casey Bertenthal) and the launch of a dedicated Enterprise tier with account management indicate formal enterprise sales build-out beyond the historical PLG motion.

Business tier priced at $16/user/month bundles AI features (Triage Intelligence, Linear Agent automations, Code Intelligence) and Enterprise tier adds SAML/SCIM and dedicated support, indicating a tiered pricing architecture optimized for monetization of AI capabilities.
